rawRecord.EXPERIMENTAL_ai_generated_description: Provides secure access to TrainingPeaks training data through cookie-based authentication. Offers tools for retrieving workout details, personal records, fitness metrics (CTL/ATL/TSB), and athlete profiles. Implements dual credential storage using system keyring with encrypted file fallback for cross-application authentication. Focuses on endurance sports analytics including training load analysis, performance tracking, and workout planning for cyclists, runners, and triathletes.
